title: Recovery: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Recovery loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Keep a spare kit at base: food, blocks, weapon, light, and a recovery compass if available. Do not retrieve valuables while naked and unprepared.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A good recovery start is calm triage: mark the death point, replace only the essentials, and return by the safest path rather than the fastest path.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Recovery is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
